blocks.title: Realisations and conventions: mathematics $\to$ physics (the forced identifications, each with its falsifier, and one definition)

rows.label: B1
rows.predicate: Gravitation is the synchronisation of elementary clocks; distance is decoherence. Falsifier: a gravitating species supplying the galactic \emph{and} cosmological abundance (\S\ref{sec:discussion}), or entanglement induced off the Newtonian rate.

rows.label: B2
rows.predicate: Mass is winding rate, $E=hf$; an acceleration advances phase at the rate $g/c$. Falsifier: a knee that does not track $H(z)$ (P1), or a rest mass with no winding.

rows.label: B3
rows.predicate: The acceleration floor is the phase-coherence threshold $g/c=\Hzero/2\pi$: the winding frequency reaches the drive's cyclic frequency (one radian of phase per Hubble time). Falsifier: a measured floor off $c\Hzero/2\pi$ beyond the $H_0$ uncertainty, or a floor that is directional or density-dependent (P6).

rows.label: B4
rows.predicate: Below the floor the registered force is read as an amplitude in the conjugate chart, the conserved flux as a count. Falsifier: a sub-floor law other than the geometric mean $\sqrt{\gb\az}$ at $x\ll1$, e.g.\ the wide-binary knee failing P3.

rows.label: B5
rows.predicate: The intrinsic scatter is the spread $\delta\alpha$ of the source's collective phase, read through the chart angle; its identification with the disk's dynamical temperature is the conjecture Y2. Falsifier: an intrinsic scatter that does not follow $\tan\alpha(x)$, i.e.\ no rise into the deep regime at fixed $\delta\alpha$ (P2).

rows.label: B6
rows.predicate: The lensing enhancement is the coherence-weighted amplitude, following the bulk-coherent components. Falsifier: a merger lensing peak tracking the shocked gas; the cluster-core residual off the amplitude-sum form over the core's composites is the exposure of the conjecture Y1.

rows.label: B7
rows.predicate: The cosmological constant is the curvature of the wrapped finite chart. Falsifier: $w\neq-1$, or a negative or scale-varying $\Lambda$ (C11).

rows.label: B8
rows.predicate: The masking barrier is the coincidence amplitude: registration fails when the killed noise walk first traverses the signal's amplitude $\sqrt x$ in the metric $\delta_A$ the floor rate induces, coefficient one. Falsifier: an approach to Newton departing from $1-e^{-\sqrt x}$ beyond the binned-RAR uncertainty (the simple rational form differs by up to $0.05$ in $\gobs/\gb$ at $\gb\approx5\az$), or a knee displaced from $c\Hzero/2\pi$ ($\kappa^{2}\neq1$).

rows.label: B9
rows.predicate: The bulk-coherence weight of a component $c$, $w_c=\bigl|\langle e^{i\theta}\rangle_c\bigr|^{2}/\langle|e^{i\theta}|^{2}\rangle_c\in[0,1]$: unity for a virialised clump whose constituents share a bulk phase, near zero for gas a merger shock has randomised.

blocks.title: What the construction explains: the surplus over the galactic and cosmological phenomenology

rows.label: X1
rows.predicate: \textbf{Newton's inverse-square law and the equivalence principle} follow from the discrete Gauss law of the synchronisation flux, the acceleration of a test cluster independent of its mass and composition.

rows.label: X2
rows.predicate: \textbf{The acceleration scale $\az=c\Hzero/2\pi$} is the phase-coherence threshold, the acceleration whose winding frequency reaches the drive's cyclic rate, the $2\pi$ the radian-to-cycle conversion of the angular Hubble rate, parameter-free, $13\%$ below the fitted value at the entailed $\Hzero$.

rows.label: X3
rows.predicate: \textbf{Flat rotation curves and the baryonic Tully--Fisher relation} $v^{4}=GM\az$ are the deep-regime geometric mean $\geff=\sqrt{\gb\az}$, the amplitude reading of the field below the floor.

rows.label: X4
rows.predicate: \textbf{The radial acceleration relation carries no fitted function}: its interpolation is the finite first-passage registration given one declared identification, the amplitude barrier (B8), and it is the curve the data selected.
rows.source: Thm.~\ref{thm:registration}, Eq.~\eqref{eq:interp}\newline \pywit{dark}{p32030}{X4}, \leanwit{FrcCore}{p32030}{X4}, \leanwit{FrcLedger}{p32030}{X4} \lean{FRC.Dark.passage\_vieta, FRC.Dark.line\_passage, Dark.registration\_root, Dark.interpolant\_discriminant, Dark.rar\_from\_count}

rows.label: X5
rows.predicate: \textbf{The relation is tight}, its intrinsic scatter ($0.04$\,dex at the knee, SPARC at fixed $\az$) smallest at high acceleration and rising as $x^{-1/4}$ into the deep regime, the spread of the collective phase.

rows.label: X6
rows.predicate: \textbf{The external-field effect breaks the strong equivalence principle}, the internal dynamics depending on the total field through the registration.

rows.label: X7
rows.predicate: \textbf{The merging-cluster lensing offset} is a selection: the coherence-weighted enhancement follows the collisionless galaxies and drops the shock-decohered gas ($C_{ij}\to0$), not a coincidence.

rows.label: X8
rows.predicate: \textbf{The cluster-core residual} is referred to the coherent amplitude addition $\sqrt{N_{\mathrm{eff}}}$ over the core's separately virialised composites, the one law that also gives the merger selection (C10); the quantitative closure, with $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$ uncomputed, is the conjecture Y1.

rows.label: X9
rows.predicate: \textbf{The cosmological constant is small}, $\Lambda\sim1/\Om$, the curvature of the finite chart and a reading of the one cardinality rather than a mode-sum vacuum energy, so no $120$-order cancellation arises.

rows.label: X10
rows.predicate: \textbf{The dark-matter and dark-energy scales coincide} because both are readings of the one cardinality $\Om$, the floor $\az=c\Hzero/2\pi$ and the curvature $\Lambda\sim1/\Om$ fixed together.

rows.label: X11
rows.predicate: \textbf{The dark sector adds no particle}: the registered acceleration is a strictly increasing function of the baryonic acceleration and the one global $\az$, so one registered acceleration fixes one baryonic acceleration with no room for a second component; the galactic discrepancy is the amplitude reading of the baryonic field, the direct-detection and axion nulls are consistent, and no dark subhaloes exist.

rows.label: P1
rows.predicate: The redshift law $\az(z)=cH(z)/2\pi$: the knee shifts and the Tully--Fisher zero-point evolves, $v_{\mathrm{flat}}\propto E(z)^{1/4}$ ($+7\%$, $+16\%$, $+32\%$ at $z=0.5,1,2$ for $\Omega_m=0.315$), parameter-free; shape resolvable, value in Z1. Falsifier: a high-$z$ knee away from $cH(z)/2\pi$, or a non-evolving Tully--Fisher zero-point.
rows.source: \S\ref{sec:predictions}\newline \pywit{dark}{p32038}{P1}, \leanwit{FrcLedger}{p32038}{P1}; rests on B2, B3, C2 \lean{Dark.running\_floor, Dark.ez\_quarter\_brackets}

rows.label: P2
rows.predicate: The scatter is the two-variable form $\sigma=(2\tan\alpha/\ln10)\,\delta\alpha$, vanishing for cold high-$x$ systems and rising as $x^{-1/4}$; SPARC at fixed $\az$: intrinsic $0.038$\,dex overall, $0.04$ at the knee, $0.13$ at $x\simeq0.02$, bounding $\delta\alpha\lesssim3.5^{\circ}$. Falsifier: a deep-regime intrinsic scatter that does not rise, or a measured collective spread the scatter does not track.

rows.label: P3
rows.predicate: Wide binaries ($\gtrsim10$\,kAU) follow $\gb/(1-e^{-\sqrt{x}})$ with the global $\az$ and the vector Galactic field $\gext\simeq1.8\az$: a $10$--$30\%$ velocity enhancement ($12$--$16\%$ at $10$--$40$\,kAU on the collinear estimate), the exponential knee distinct from Newtonian and rational forms. Falsifier: Newtonian wide-binary motion, or a knee of the wrong shape.
rows.source: \S\ref{sec:predictions}\newline \pywit{dark}{p32040}{P3}, \leanwit{FrcLedger}{p32040}{P3}; rests on B4, B8, C6, C9 \lean{Dark.wide\_binary\_band}

rows.label: P4
rows.predicate: Pressure-supported systems (ellipticals, dSphs, UDGs) lie below the cold-disk relation by the coherence factor $\sqrt{w}$, $w=1/(1+(\sigma_v/v)^{2})$, by $0.05$--$0.15$\,dex for $\sigma_v/v=0.5$--$1$, correlating with $\sigma_v/v$. Falsifier: pressure-supported systems on the cold-disk relation.

rows.label: P5
rows.predicate: Coherence-state cluster gas: the X-ray gas gravitates only when bulk-coherent, contributing in a relaxed cluster ($C_{ij}\to1$) and dropping out of a merger ($C_{ij}\to0$), the lensing displacement growing with the shock Mach number; the quantitative core residual of the same law is the conjecture Y1. rows.label: P6
rows.predicate: A global, isotropic scale and no dark substructure: the registered acceleration depends on the baryonic field and the one global $\az$ alone, strictly increasing, with no direction or environment in the law once the external field is in its argument; no new dark-matter state and no dark subhaloes, so stream perturbations and the satellite abundance trace baryons alone. Falsifier: a directional or density dependence of $\az$ beyond the external-field effect, or stream gaps and substructure lensing with no baryonic counterpart.

rows.label: Y1
rows.predicate: The cluster-core residual as the coherent amplitude addition \eqref{eq:cohsum} over the core's separately virialised composites, $\sqrt{N_{\mathrm{eff}}}$ over the smooth boost, the law that also gives the Bullet selection. Exposure: the coherence criterion is not derived; the radial acceleration relation forces $N_{\mathrm{eff}}=1$ within a galaxy (\S\ref{sub:clustermag}), while the relaxed-core residual requires $N_{\mathrm{eff}}\simeq4$, uncomputed (\S\ref{sub:clustermag}). Deciding computation: $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$ from the core galaxy populations of \citet{sanders2003,pointecouteau2005}.

rows.label: Y2
rows.predicate: The collective phase spread as the disk's dynamical temperature, $\delta\alpha=\arctan(\sigma_v/v_{\mathrm{circ}})$. Exposure: at $\sigma_v/v\simeq0.1$--$0.2$ the law gives two to four times the SPARC intrinsic scatter at every $x$; the knee bounds $\delta\alpha\lesssim3.5^{\circ}$; the within-galaxy scatter of $116$ disks shows no correlation with $1/V_{\mathrm{flat}}$ ($\rho=-0.02$). Test: the scatter against measured dispersions.

C1.name: FRC.Drift.gauss_law
C1.doc: 21:C11, 00:E3, 00:E4, 32:C1, 32:X1, 32:C4 — the Gauss law: for antisymmetric link currents `J_xy = −J_yx` on `n` sites, the divergence `Σ_y J_xy` summed over a region `R` equals the flux through its boundary, `Σ_{x ∈ R} Σ_{y ∉ R} J_xy`: the interior links cancel in pairs.

C1.name: FRC.Dark.enclosed_flux
C1.doc: 32:C1, 32:X1, 32:C4 — the flux through the boundary of a region equals the source it encloses: for antisymmetric link currents with divergence `src`, `Σ_{x∈R} Σ_{y∉R} J_xy = Σ_{x∈R} src x` (the Gauss law). A unit source inside gives unit flux through every enclosing surface.

C1.name: FRC.Dark.source_free_flux
C1.doc: 32:C1, 32:X1, 32:C4 — a source-free current has zero flux through every closed surface: the floor noise, zero-mean and source-free, leaves the mean force unchanged.

C1.name: FRC.Dark.flux_superposition
C1.doc: 32:C1, 32:X1 — superposition: the flux of `J + K` is the sum of the fluxes — a source-free perturbation adds nothing.

C3.name: FRC.Dark.parallelogram
C3.doc: 32:C3 — the parallelogram law of the extension norm: `N(a + b) + N(a − b) = 2N(a) + 2N(b)` — the cross terms of two phasors cancel between the two signs.

C3.name: FRC.Dark.coherent_stack
C3.doc: 32:C3, 32:C10 — the coherent stack: `n` copies of one phasor have norm `n²N(u)` (`norm_scale` with `c = ofNat n`).

C3.name: FRC.Dark.incoherent_mean
C3.doc: 32:C3 — the incoherent mean: the norms of the `2^n` signed sums add up to `2^n` times the sum of the norms, so the mean squared amplitude of an incoherent ensemble is `Σ N(u_k)` (the count `n` for unit phasors), its amplitude `√n`, while the coherent stack has `n²`.

C4.name: FRC.Dark.tully_fisher
C4.doc: 32:C4, 32:C5, 32:X3 — the amplitude reading squared is the flux: with `s² = G M a₀` (the deep-regime registered force times `r`) and `v² = s` (the circular speed, `v² = g r` with `g = s/r`), `v⁴ = G M a₀` — the baryonic Tully–Fisher relation as a ring identity.

C4.name: FRC.Dark.source_free_flux
C4.doc: 32:C1, 32:X1, 32:C4 — a source-free current has zero flux through every closed surface: the floor noise, zero-mean and source-free, leaves the mean force unchanged.

C6.name: FRC.Dark.passage_vieta
C6.doc: 32:C6, 32:X4, 32:C7 — Vieta for the first-passage quadratic: two distinct roots `f ≠ g` of `z(x² + 1) = 2x` have `z(f + g) = 2` and `f g = 1` (`z ≠ 0`): the second root is `1/f`, the long route round the cycle.

C6.name: FRC.Dark.line_passage
C6.doc: 32:C7, 32:C6, 32:X4 — the line solution: `u_k = f^k` solves the recursion at every interior step, `z(f^k + f^{k+2}) = 2 f^{k+1}`.

C7.name: FRC.Dark.passage_step
C7.doc: 32:C7, 32:B8 — one step of the killed walk's recursion: if `z(f² + 1) = 2f` (the single-step generating factor `f` of the first-passage quadratic `(z/2)f² − f + z/2 = 0`), then for every `t` (standing for `f^k`) `z(t + t f²) = 2 t f`: the sequence `u_k = f^k` satisfies `z(u_{k−1} + u_{k+1}) = 2u_k`.

C7.name: FRC.Dark.line_passage
C7.doc: 32:C7, 32:C6, 32:X4 — the line solution: `u_k = f^k` solves the recursion at every interior step, `z(f^k + f^{k+2}) = 2 f^{k+1}`.

C7.name: FRC.Dark.cycle_passage
C7.doc: 32:C7, 32:B8 — the two-image solution on the cycle `Z_N` with the absorbing point at distance `k+1` one way and `j+1` the other (`N = k + j + 2`): `u = f^{·} + f^{N−·}` satisfies the same recursion, `z(u_{k} + u_{k+2}) = 2u_{k+1}`, written with the two exponents `k, j`; the normalisation by `1 + f^N` makes the absorbing value one.

C7.name: FRC.Dark.passage_vieta
C7.doc: 32:C6, 32:X4, 32:C7 — Vieta for the first-passage quadratic: two distinct roots `f ≠ g` of `z(x² + 1) = 2x` have `z(f + g) = 2` and `f g = 1` (`z ≠ 0`): the second root is `1/f`, the long route round the cycle.
